bio.text: Bill Hill is a nonpartisan candidate for Alaska's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026, running against incumbent Republican Nick Begich.
He is Dena'ina Athabascan, lives in Naknek in Bristol Bay, and grew up in the village of Kokhanok on Iliamna Lake.
He spent 25 years in education as a teacher, principal and superintendent, and works as a commercial fisherman.
He and his wife Diane own Bristol Bay Brailer, a company that makes brailers for the commercial fishing industry.
